today.title: Today
today.lead: Nothing is sent without your approval.
today.setUpTitle: First, tell the agents who you are
today.setUpBody: When agents find a job, prepare an application or draft a reply to a recruiter, it waits for you here. Start by telling them who you are and what you want next.
today.goalsTitle: Now, what do you want next?
today.goalsBody: A few short questions about the roles, places and pay you want: searches keep to them. {{answered}} of {{total}} answered.
today.searchBody: Your profile and goals are set. Search the job boards now: the good matches land in your Pipeline as Found, with why they match and their gaps.
today.matchesBody: A search found jobs that fit your profile and goals. Open them, shortlist the ones you like, and say “Not for me” to the rest.
today.nothingBody: No new matches since your last look. Another search runs tonight, or search again now.
